strings: All the coughing has left m_c's throat ragged and torn feeling.
With all the coughing from m_c's longcough r_c is unsurprised when {PRONNOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/get/gets} a sore throat.
With a pained grumble m_c wanders towards r_c0's den hoping for some honey to sooothe {PRONNOUN/m_c/poss} throat.
